# Load Packages/Data

library(tidyverse)
library(gssr)
library(haven)

# Load full GSS cumulative dataset 
data(gss_all)

# Filter Data/ Clean Core Variables
gss_analyst <- gss_all |>
  # Select core political, abortion policy, and demographic variables
  select(year, age, sex, polviews, partyid, abany) |>
  
  # Zap survey missing values (e.g., "Don't Know", "Refused")
  mutate(across(everything(), haven::zap_missing)) |>
  
  # Recode and group variables into clean, human-readable categories
  mutate(
    # Calculate approximate birth year
    birth_year = as.numeric(year) - as.numeric(age),
    
    # Categorize into Generational Cohorts
    generation = case_when(
      birth_year >= 1997 ~ "Gen Z",
      birth_year >= 1981 & birth_year <= 1996 ~ "Millennial",
      birth_year >= 1965 & birth_year <= 1980 ~ "Gen X",
      birth_year >= 1946 & birth_year <= 1964 ~ "Baby Boomer",
      birth_year < 1946 ~ "Silent/Prior"
    ),
    generation = factor(generation, levels = c("Silent/Prior", "Baby Boomer", "Gen X", "Millennial", "Gen Z")),
    
    # Variable 1: Political Ideology (Grouped from 7-point scale)
    ideology = case_when(
      as.numeric(polviews) %in% 1:3 ~ "Liberal",
      as.numeric(polviews) == 4     ~ "Moderate",
      as.numeric(polviews) %in% 5:7 ~ "Conservative"
    ),
    
    # Variable 2: Party Identification (Grouped from 7-point scale)
    party_affiliation = case_when(
      as.numeric(partyid) %in% 0:2 ~ "Democrat / Lean Dem",
      as.numeric(partyid) == 3     ~ "Independent",
      as.numeric(partyid) %in% 4:6 ~ "Republican / Lean Rep"
    ),
    
    # Variable 3: Abortion Policy Stance (abany - Abortion for Any Reason)
    abortion_view = case_when(
      as.numeric(abany) == 1 ~ "Allow for Any Reason",
      as.numeric(abany) == 2 ~ "Restrict / Oppose"
    ),
    
    # Demographic Moderator: Gender
    gender = case_when(
      as.numeric(sex) == 1 ~ "Male",
      as.numeric(sex) == 2 ~ "Female"
    )
  ) |>
  
  # Filter to young adults aged 18 to 25 ONLY for an accurate life-stage comparison
  filter(as.numeric(age) >= 18 & as.numeric(age) <= 25, !is.na(generation))

#1. Calculate overall survey year range per generation first
gen_years <- gss_analyst |>
  filter(!is.na(ideology)) |>
  group_by(generation) |>
  summarize(
    start_year = min(as.numeric(year)),
    end_year = max(as.numeric(year)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Table 1: Overall Ideology across Generations (Ages 18–25)
ideology_table <- gss_analyst |>
  filter(!is.na(ideology)) |>
  group_by(generation, ideology) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(percent = round((n / sum(n)) * 100, 1)) |>
  left_join(gen_years, by = "generation") |>
  mutate(
    years_sampled = paste0(start_year, "–", end_year),
    axis_label = paste0(generation, "\n(", start_year, "–", end_year, ")"),
    # Enforce strict chronological order on the X-axis (Boomer -> Gen X -> Millennial -> Gen Z)
    axis_label = fct_reorder(axis_label, as.numeric(generation))
  )

print(select(ideology_table, generation, years_sampled, ideology, n, percent))

# Table 2: Party Identification across Generations (Ages 18–25)
party_table <- gss_analyst |>
  filter(!is.na(party_affiliation)) |>
  group_by(generation, party_affiliation) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(percent = round((n / sum(n)) * 100, 1))

print(party_table)

# Table 3: Abortion Policy View across Generations (Ages 18–25)
abortion_table <- gss_analyst |>
  filter(!is.na(abortion_view)) |>
  group_by(generation, abortion_view) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(percent = round((n / sum(n)) * 100, 1))

print(abortion_table)

# Table 4: Key Demographic Factor — Gen Z Ideology split by Gender
genz_gender_table <- gss_analyst |>
  filter(generation == "Gen Z", !is.na(ideology), !is.na(gender)) |>
  group_by(gender, ideology) |>
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(percent = round((n / sum(n)) * 100, 1))

print(genz_gender_table)

# Chart 1: Ideology Across Generations (Chronological & Unified Groups)
ggplot(ideology_table, aes(x = axis_label, y = percent, fill = ideology)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Liberal" = "#2B5C8F", "Moderate" = "#708090", "Conservative" = "#D95F02")) +
  labs(
    title = "Political Ideology of Young Adults (Ages 18–25) Across Generations",
    subtitle = "Comparing ideological self-identification at the exact same life stage",
    x = "Generational Cohort & Survey Period",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Ideology"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save Chart 1
ggsave("chart1_ideology_across_generations.png", width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Chart 2: Views on Abortion Access Across Generations (Ages 18–25)
ggplot(abortion_table, aes(x = generation, y = percent, fill = abortion_view)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Allow for Any Reason" = "#2E8B57", "Restrict / Oppose" = "#B22222")) +
  labs(
    title = "Support for Abortion Access (Ages 18–25) Across Generations",
    subtitle = "Comparing approval for abortion for any reason at age 18–25",
    x = "Generational Cohort",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Abortion Stance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save Chart 2
ggsave("chart2_abortion_policy_trend.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Chart 3: Gen Z Ideology Split by Gender (Young Adults Ages 18–25)
ggplot(genz_gender_table, aes(x = gender, y = percent, fill = ideology)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Liberal" = "#2B5C8F", "Moderate" = "#708090", "Conservative" = "#D95F02")) +
  labs(
    title = "Gen Z Political Ideology by Gender (Ages 18–25)",
    subtitle = "Comparing ideological self-identification between Gen Z men and women",
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Ideology"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Save Chart 3
ggsave("chart3_genz_gender_divide.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
